nodes.name: One-pot coreduction and in situ template formation
nodes.procedure: Synthesis was achieved via one-pot coreduction of metal precursors in the presence of CTAC. Copper and palladium precursors were rapidly reduced (within 3 min) to form CuPd alloy nanoparticles in situ, which then served as templates for the epitaxial growth of Ru shells. The Ru crystal phase (fcc vs hcp) was regulated by adjusting the Cu/Pd ratio to modulate lattice mismatch.

unit_operations.name: In situ Template Formation
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: Cu and Pd precursors were rapidly reduced into spherical nanoparticles at the initial stage (>98% conversion within 3 min)... serve as the template for controlled surface deposition

unit_operations.name: Epitaxial Growth
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: Cu2+/Cu exhibits a lower reduction potential (0.34 V vs SHE), which drives galvanic replacement between Cu and Ru3+ to guide Ru deposition

nodes.source_text: The phase-regulatable synthesis of Ru-based core-shell nanocrystals was achieved in one pot... Cu and Pd precursors were rapidly reduced into spherical nanoparticles at the initial stage (>98% conversion within 3 min).

nodes.name: Selective chemical etching to nanocages
nodes.procedure: The CuPd@Ru core-shell nanocrystals were transformed into hollow Ru nanocages by selectively removing the core using Fe3+ and HCl as etchants. Pt atoms embedded in the Ru shells were retained due to high resistance to oxidative etching.

unit_operations.name: Selective Etching
